items.title: File Einspruch against vehicle tax assessment
items.quote: Die Frist dafür beträgt einen Monat; sie beginnt mit der Bekanntgabe, die bei einfachem Brief am vierten Tag nach dem Absenden als erfolgt gilt.
items.computation: Letter dated Wed 22.10.2025; assuming this is also the day of Aufgabe zur Post (mailing), the statutory Bekanntgabefiktion for simple mail under § 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO (as in force since 2017: 'am vierten Tage nach Aufgabe zur Post') places delivery on the 4th day after mailing, i.e. 26.10.2025. That day is a Sunday; per settled case law applying § 108 Abs. 3 AO by analogy to the delivery fiction itself, a fictitious delivery date falling on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday is shifted to the next business day, i.e. Monday 27.10.2025. This is therefore the 'Ereignistag' (Bekanntgabe) that starts the one-month Einspruchsfrist under § 355 Abs. 1 AO. Per § 108 Abs. 1 AO i.V.m. §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB, a monthly period triggered by an event ends on the day of the following month bearing the same calendar number as the event day, i.e. 27.11.2025. That day is a Thursday and not a public holiday in NRW, so no further shift is needed.

warnings: The exact mailing date (Tag der Aufgabe zur Post) is not printed separately from the document date; the deadline calculation assumes they are the same day (22.10.2025), which can shift the result by a day or two if mailing actually occurred later.
The letter states the Kraftfahrzeugsteuer will continue to be collected by Lastschrift (direct debit) but gives no specific payment date, so no separate payment item could be created for it.
